facts.fact: 半队 Hemlock 从机车场往南，她跟着的另一半往北。
facts.anchor: Half of the Hemlocks went south from the train yard, and the other half—the half that I’m now with—went north.

facts.fact: Evelyn 推开墙板，把装衣服鞋子的包挪到一边，掏出另一样东西。
facts.anchor: Only she just shoves it aside and takes out something else:

facts.fact: 那些枪是从 Dauntless 墙卫手上偷的，装子弹，不装针剂。
facts.anchor: stolen from the Dauntless wall guards and loaded with bullets, not needles

facts.fact: 她断定这一趟的目的就是杀 Marcus Eaton。
facts.anchor: I know where we’re going: to kill Marcus Eaton.

facts.fact: 跳下车后她有个怪念头：她若想跑，Sly 会追上来。
facts.anchor: I have the strangest feeling that if I tried to run, she would chase me.

facts.fact: 她不用规划路线，这一片城区她熟得不能再熟。
facts.anchor: I don’t need to plan our route; I know this part of the city backward and forward.

facts.fact: 她认定 Marcus 光是存在着就在伤害 Tobias。
facts.anchor: and he hurts him just by existing

facts.fact: 月光照在 Eric 脸上的穿孔上反光。
facts.anchor: moonlight glinting off the piercings in his face
